name: ps2_logo
title: PS2 texture test
description: One texture on a cleared screen. A bisection tool for a black screen, not a game.
detail: Draws exactly one thing: the logo, as a texture. If this shows the logo, the texture path works and a fault is elsewhere. If it shows a blue screen, the frame loop runs but the texture does not. If it is black, the GS never came up. Guessing which of those is true from a black screen is not debugging.
